notes.title: Dev Log #1 - Still Cooking
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! Hope you're having a good day.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm keeping things casual from now on, no more overly formal stuff. I’ll be sharing updates in a more relaxed style, kinda like how you'd talk with a friend. Might even throw in a meme or two if it fits.[/p][p][/p][h2]So, why did this update take so long?[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968530/1453cad6b24a38470e901ed614c281eda6f73a81.png"][/img][/p][p]At first, I just planned to rework the main features, like Bots menu, main menu, and In-game system. But turns out, my old code was pretty messy. Every time I changed one thing, something else would break. Seriously, it was chaos.[/p][p]So yeah, I ended up redoing everything from scratch. Honestly, it felt like I was building the whole game all over again.[/p][p][/p][p]Alright, let’s jump into the actual progress for this major update:[/p][p][/p][h3]Done[/h3][list][*][p]Refactored almost all the code.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized code and assets in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Redesign the UI/UX and sprites (especially the layout and coloring).[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled the main system:[/p][list][*][p]Save/load logic.[/p][/*][*][p]Database.[/p][/*][*][p]Loading system.[/p][/*][*][p]Code and asset performance.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rebuilt Bots menu (for each class):[/p][list][*][p]Profile.[/p][/*][*][p]Talent.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]Various skills.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rebuilt main menu:[/p][list][*][p]Inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Lab.[/p][/*][*][p]Setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Cloud save.[/p][/*][*][p]Stage selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Stage preparation.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rebuilt in-game UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuilt in-game camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuilt in-game animation system.[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled Bots movement and control.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]To do[/h3][list][*][p]Polish the in-game camera system.[/p][/*][*][p]Redesign all stages in all game modes.[/p][/*][*][p]Create codes and assets for all Bot skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Improve the visual effects of all Bot skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Create enemies asset, skills, and AI.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuild task menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuild player profile (including achievement and badges).[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuild extra menu (gift code, cross-platform cloud save, etc.).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Still cooking![/h2][p]Right now, I’d say the update’s about [b]55% complete[/b]. Some big stuff’s already done, but there’s still a bit to wrap up before it’s ready to drop.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for sticking with me, I’ll keep the updates coming![/p]

notes.title: Progress Towards v2.0
notes.content:
I've had failure after failure. Day after day, I see numbers with very small numbers. After more than 4 years of development, it seems that fatigue and disappointment are all I have gotten. The tons of ideas that I poured my heart into felt like a waste. “[i]Why did I get into this industry? Why did I want to make my own game so badly? Why after all this hard work did it not pay off at all? Why?[/i]”

However, in the midst of these dark thoughts, I remembered the behavior of the children in my neighborhood who became aggressive with their own friends. Unintentionally, I heard a term that is very much related to the gaming world. Their unstable nature and selfishness when playing games are the cause of the endless arguments. It felt strange, but it was the glimmer of light that brought back the color to my eyes. The love and hatred in my heart still hasn't faded, and it seems like it will stay with me forever. Without realizing it, this love, hatred, fatigue, and disappointment became fuel that never went out. With this firm determination, I will keep moving forward to refine this game.

[h3]What's the point of this news?[/h3]
The next update (v2.0) is a major update for the first time in this game. Most aspects will be affected by this update. I've been working on this update every day since April 27th, but it's still not finished. That said, the progress for this update is about 35% complete. For the spoilers, you can check them out on my social media.

I still need a lot of time to continue this update, because I'm working on everything by myself. So, please bear with me in advance. Don't worry, as long as I'm alive and have full control over this game, I'll keep taking care of this game.

notes.title: Demo Version Available!
notes.content:
After I monitored Odd Sequence sales from April 22, 2024, I finally understood why Odd Sequence wasn't selling well. This game desperately needs a [b]demo version[/b]. No one wants to spend their money on an unclear game, right?

[h3]Now, the demo version is out![/h3]
This demo version will allow you to play Odd Sequence for free for 30 minutes. 
[b]Wait, it's only 30 minutes?[/b] Well yes, but actually no. 
[b]What do you mean?[/b] Please continue reading this announcement until the end!

[h3]What will happen if my playtime in this demo version is more than 30 minutes?[/h3]
You will get a notification in the game, and you will close the game after closing the notification.

[h3]Can I play the demo version again after I reach the playtime limit?[/h3]
[b]Yes, of course![/b]
I don't know about the demo versions of other games. But, in Odd Sequence, you can play again, even your playtime in this demo version is more than 30 minutes. Your demo playtime will [b]reset automatically every week[/b] (on Mondays). You can play the demo version again for 30 minutes after the playtime reset. A good deal for you, right?

[h3]I've played the demo version, and I've purchased and installed the full version.[/h3]
Please uninstall the demo version. Because, why would you play the demo version if you have the full version? This will also free up some of your storage.
